responsibility: Implements the registry and command-driven enable/disable logic for named Go frontend optimization switches controlled by `-fgo-optimize-*`. It keeps the global list of `Go_optimize` descriptors and exposes the C entry point used by option handling to toggle individual optimizations or all registered frontend optimization knobs.
same_name_distinction: Implements the registry and command handler for `-fgo-optimize-*` controls, maintaining the global list of `Go_optimize` descriptors and toggling named or `all` optimizations. Unlike go-optimize.h, this file contains the registry state and enable/disable logic.
